Using the web, explain whether SQLite WAL allows readers and a writer at the same time. Cite evidence.
cases.reviewTarget: WAL permits readers and a writer concurrently, not multiple concurrent writers.

cases.question: Using the web, explain whether SQLite foreign-key enforcement needs enabling for a connection. Cite evidence.
cases.query: site:sqlite.org/foreignkeys.html enabling foreign key support per connection
cases.reviewTarget: Foreign keys must be enabled separately per connection unless defaults are compiled differently.

cases.question: Using the web, explain how PostgreSQL Read Committed chooses a SELECT snapshot. Cite evidence.
cases.reviewTarget: Read Committed SELECT observes committed data as of the query beginning; successive SELECTs may differ.

cases.question: Using the web, explain Tavily basic versus advanced search credits. Cite evidence.
cases.reviewTarget: Basic search costs one credit and advanced costs two; avoid unrelated extraction-credit claims.

cases.question: Using the web, explain what Tavily max_age_hours zero means and its limitation on non-paying plans. Cite evidence.
cases.query: site:docs.tavily.com max_age_hours 0 live best effort non paying plans 434
cases.reviewTarget: Zero forces live fetching; inaccessible results are omitted; non-paying plans are best effort and may receive 434.

cases.question: Using the web, explain whether an HTTP EventSource automatically reconnects. Cite evidence.
cases.reviewTarget: EventSource normally reconnects; event IDs can support resumption, but application replay requires server support.

cases.question: Using the web, explain whether browser microphone capture requires a secure context. Cite evidence.
cases.query: site:developer.mozilla.org getUserMedia secure context localhost HTTPS
cases.reviewTarget: getUserMedia requires secure contexts, with localhost treated as trustworthy.

cases.question: Using the web, explain why a current price alone cannot establish its change date. Cite any relevant evidence and clearly separate your inference.
cases.reviewTarget: Retrieval timing alone cannot establish an effective change date; label this logical inference.
